description: This file defines a PHP class 'CustomField' which is an entity for ORM mapping to the 'hs_hr_custom_fields' database table. It includes constants for field types and screens, properties with annotations for database columns, and getter/setter methods for each property, serving as a model for custom fields in an HR management system.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Entity class mapping to 'hs_hr_custom_fields' table, representing customizable fields within the HR system.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the custom field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the custom field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the custom field (string or select).

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the custom field.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen context where the field appears.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen context for the custom field.

methods.name: getExtraData
methods.description: Returns any additional data associated with the field.

methods.name: setExtraData
methods.description: Sets additional data for the custom field.
